symbols.name: matrix
symbols.meaning: A matrix whose entry in row i and column j is p_{ij}.
symbols.quote: Let $P=(p_{ij})$ be a matrix, with $p_{ij}$ its entry in row $i$ and column $j$.

symbols.name: second matrix
symbols.meaning: A second matrix, which is copied once for each entry of P in the tensor product P \otimes Q.

symbols.name: tensor product
symbols.meaning: The operation that forms the block matrix P \otimes Q, also called the Kronecker product.
symbols.quote: The tensor product $P\otimes Q$, also called the Kronecker product, is the block matrix whose block in block-row $i$ and block-column $j$ is $p_{ij}Q$.

symbols.name: number of factors
symbols.meaning: The number of copies of P in the power P^{\otimes m}, which is also the number of address coordinates the operator acts on.
symbols.quote: Here $m$ is the number of factors in a tensor power, which is also the number of coordinates that the operator acts on.

relations.quote: The tensor product is built from matrices, the basic objects of [Linear algebra basics](linear-algebra-basics.md).
